comparison_states: Paper-defined comparison pairs: Cr(III)/Co(II) doublet/quartet; Cr(II)/Mn(III)/Fe(II)/Co(III) singlet/quintet; Mn(II)/Fe(III) doublet/sextet. The metric compares this specified pair for each metal and oxidation state.
donor_features: Charge plus 31 nontrivial donor-centred ligand-only RACs; use Z, Pauling electronegativity, graph degree T, identity I and covalent radius S. Product sums are p(center)*sum(p(shell)); difference sums are sum(p(center)-p(shell)). Identity difference and depth-zero identity product are omitted.
donor_order: Positions 0,1,2,3 are equatorial; 4,5 axial. Trans pairs (0,2),(1,3),(4,5); all other pairs cis. This layout agrees with the deposited donor features and octahedral cis-angle criterion.
graph: Element-labelled integer atom indices, with the metal at index zero. Metal-donor edges join whole-ligand element-adjacency graphs; bond-order and stereochemical variants share this representation.
graph_construction: Remove the metal; join atoms at distance <1.15 times the sum of fixed source molSimplify covalent radii; choose the six nearest nonhydrogen donors. All 1933 source geometries reproduce every donor RAC within 1e-8 and admit the source octahedral cis-layout criterion.
ligand_identity: Whole-ligand molecular formula, element-labelled adjacency and total integer charge define equivalence. Donor choices, bond-order assignments and stereochemical variants share a group when this criterion matches.
numerical_unit: Adiabatic E_HS(R_HS)-E_LS(R_LS) in kcal/mol. Inputs comprise graph topology, donor layout and structural autocorrelations; orbital energies and reference target fields are excluded.
public_source_warning: Retrospective evaluation against public source targets. Original test labels were inspected during partition design, and prior exposure to public targets is possible. The target is the deposited reference computation.

reference_protocol.scope: The target consists of deposited numerical references. The paper specifies these settings for newly generated tests and reports consistency with its curated prior-study training data.
reference_protocol.software: TeraChem developer version; exact revision not stated in the paper

source_precomputed_standard_rac_generati: Pinned many_body_ml scripts_and_notebooks/preprocessing/featurize_raw_data.ipynb; five-property product/difference graph autocorrelations, depths 0..3, declared 155 columns, including axial/equatorial charge and denticity averages.
standard_racs: 155 source structural product/difference autocorrelations through graph depth 3, with trivial terms removed; the full column names define scope, property, depth and axial/equatorial averaging.
structural_constant_scope: Bond-inference radii and donor-RAC radii use the distinct tables listed here. Donor-RAC metal electronegativity is null; standard RACs use the pinned source-precomputed values.
total_charge: Metal oxidation state plus the sum of whole-ligand integer charges.
